correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the map from the coordinate updates in RESULT.md lines 23–46. A single step has trace 2(1−r), determinant 1−r and discriminant −4r(1−r). The two-step map has trace 2−4r+4r²−rU and determinant (1−r)². In its real monic quadratic the Schur expressions 1−det and p(1) are strictly positive, respectively r(2−r) and r(U+2−3r); p(−1) is F_U(r). A zero of p(−1) yields distinct multipliers −1 and −(1−r)². If p(−1)<0 there is one root below −1 and a stable complementary eigenline. The intervening phase is fixed and invertible, so the convergence and generic growth conclusions extend to the full trajectory. Independently minimizing the boundary U=5r−6+4/r gives its unique minimum 4√5−6 at the interior r=2/√5; only this r is marginal at q=q*. The quadratic roots are positive, F_U(1)=3−U, and the vertex for U*<U≤3 lies inside (0,1); this recovers all root/interval cases. Phase reversal gives similar products. Exact multiplication at (r,q,t)=(4/5,3,4/5) gives P entries (−7/5,16/25;−4/15,7/75) and p(−1)=−4/15. The exact identities above and RESULT.md lines 30–60 are replay paths.
